_comment: Edge smoothness floor, measured from the shipped weight maps. edgeRough is the staircase (higher is worse); edgeWidth is the transition in pixels. A build may not ship an edge rougher than these; width is held to an absolute 2.4 px rather than to the previous build, since a properly resolved boundary is both narrower and smoother. Set after the input downscale was made an integration rather than a resample - drawImage aliases when reducing, and stadium-hoodie-m is the only source above the analysis grid - taking it from 116.7 to 90.9 and the mean to 76.2. A real photographic edge, measured with no pipeline in between (scratch/measure_photo_edge.cjs), reads 68 to 85 at these widths - so below about 85 this number no longer separates a defect from the picture and the crops decide. The six tank and sweatshirt entries were measured on first admission rather than improved to - they are new garments, and a floor set at what they actually read is the only honest one. Edited deliberately, with crops compared, never to make a red build green.
